description: ensure_dns_cleanup_registered registers a Proc that calls back into the class, so PeriodicCleanup holds a closure referencing the singleton state. There is no unregister path, so a client that disables cache_enabled can never remove itself. The class-level @@dns_cache also conflates with per-instance @config.dns.cache_enabled — the first caller's config wins, subsequent clients with cache_enabled=false still write to the shared cache. When extracting DnsCache, scope the cleanup proc to the new class, document the lifecycle, and consider making the cache instance-scoped if practical. Blocked by c1h.2 (DnsCache extraction).
title: Fix DNS cache cleanup registration leak
